subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], Thank you for booking your flight with us. We are pleased to confirm your reservation for the upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: - Flight: ABC123 - Departure: 10th March 2023, 8:00 AM - Arrival: 10th March 2023, 11:30 AM Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. Safe travels! Best regards, The Travel Team
